headline: Dallas Rapper MO3 Murder Case Verdict: Kewon White Guilty of Capital Murder
body: Jurors have reached a verdict in the first case to be tried in the murder of Dallas rapper MO3 in 2020. Kewon White, allegedly hired by Yella Beezy (Markies Conway) to kill MO3, was found guilty of capital murder. The judge sentenced White to life in prison without parole. Prosecutors claim White ambushed MO3 for a promised payment, while the defense argues the state proved murder but not murder-for-hire. Jurors viewed video showing MO3 jumping from his gold Honda before being chased by a masked suspect on Interstate 35E.

source_evidence.feed_description: Story - Story - The jury has reached a verdict in the first case to be tried in the case involving Dallas rapper MO3’s murder in 2020, when Melvin Noble was killed in an ambush shooting on Interstate 35E. The first man to be tried was Kewon White, who allegedly was hired by Markies Conway to murder Noble. Conway is another rapper, known as Yella Beezy, who allegedly was embroiled in a feud with MO3. On Friday, Sept. 4, jurors handed down a guilty verdict of capital murder. The judge sentenced White to life in prison without parole. Prosecutors say White ambushed the Dallas rapper for a promised payment. The defense says the state proved a murder — but not murder-for-hire. Jurors were shown video of the ambush that showed MO3 jumping out of the gold Honda he was driving before a masked suspect chased him down the freeway with a gun.
